notes.title: Terrain Of Magical Expertise - Patch 211101 is now live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40299562/646afcb0ab726aa595e37e1ded99beb752d6783f.jpg

Greetings hackers!

We are back with another update for Terrain of Magical Expertise! We've fixed the bugged quest that had issues with collecting gems from the "Cleartz" enemies in Prehnite Peaks.  

Furthermore, we'd like to let you know that the OST is available on our Bandcamp . And that is not all! A special fully-animated OVA called "Terrain of Magical Expertise: GENESIS" will be released on TOME's YouTube channel for TOME's 10th anniversary on November 11th.

We would also like to use this opportunity to thank all of our fans, who share their feedback and / or support in our Steam Forums. It helps us immensely with identifying bugs and other issues we should fix a thus making the game better for everyone. So here's a huge THANK YOU to all members of our community ❤️

notes.title: Terrain Of Magical Expertise - Patch 211021 is now live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40299562/646afcb0ab726aa595e37e1ded99beb752d6783f.jpg

Greetings hackers!

We are back with another update for Terrain of Magical Expertise! This update fixes the softlocking issues that still affected some players, brings in expanded support for the ASUS Aura  and a plethora of other fixes and improvements.

We would also like to use this opportunity to thank all of our fans, who share their feedback and / or support in our Steam Forums. It helps us immensely with identifying bugs and other issues we should fix a thus making the game better for everyone. So here's a huge THANK YOU to all members of our community ❤️


 More ASUS Products are now compatible with the same glow effects found in the ASUS Keyboard!
 Set up assurances to prevent softlocks after Smooch's Rhythm Battle and secret boss fight in the "Kiwi Caverns".
 Rhythm Battle notes now stop moving forward when successfully hit to prevent them from triggering damage SFX despite being successfully dealt with.
 Minor spelling/localization errors fixed.
 More glitches have been fixed for when you start a New Game after finishing the credits sequence on another file.
 The "Flowered" status ailment now carries other status ailments back and forth with it.
 Abilities are now ensured to be completed when a character is KO'd, preventing other softlocks from happening after an enemy is defeated.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1543430/Terrain_of_Magical_Expertise/

notes.title: Terrain Of Magical Expertise - Patch 211006 is now live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40299562/646afcb0ab726aa595e37e1ded99beb752d6783f.jpg

Greetings hackers!

Another update for TOME is here! This patch addresses the softlocking issues that affected some players in certain parts of the game, brings in fix for the black-screen issue and some other smaller improvements. 

We would also like to use this opportunity to thank all of our fans, who share their feedback and / or support in our Steam Forums. It helps us immensely with identifying bugs and other issues we should fix a thus making the game better for everyone. So here's a huge THANK YOU to all members of our community ❤️

Read the full changelog below:

 PS3 controllers now have maps set up and should be functional.
 Fully-animated cutscene videos have better safety code in place (for players they were showing up as black screens for some reason)
 Fixed an issue with having incorrect party members appear when starting a New Game after finishing another file
 Softlocks for the Blackjack minigame found in "Goldhattan Casino" and at the end of Week 4's "Lychee Lagoon" mission should be fixed

notes.title: Terrain Of Magical Expertise - Patch 210929 is now live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40299562/646afcb0ab726aa595e37e1ded99beb752d6783f.jpg

Greetings Hackers!

We are back again with another update for TOME, this time we bring you fixes for areas, where players could fall off, some small language fixes  and most importantly fixes for most of the soft-locks that players encountered and reported. 

We tried as best as we could but STILL haven't been able to fix the soft-lock happening at the end of the "Lychee Lagoon" stage that has been happening to players at random. We are continuing to work on it and even got some outside help with trying to figure it out, but it will still take us time 😔

We would also like to use this opportunity to thank all of our fans, who share their feedback and / or support in our Steam Forums. It helps us immensely with identifying bugs and other issues we should fix a thus making the game better for everyone. So here's a huge THANK YOU to all members of our community ❤️


 Fixed a few areas where players had fallen off the stage or gotten caught on slopes
 Cleaned up several enemy techniques and AI that were previously causing softlocks and glitches during battles
 Corrected minor spelling errors


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1543430/Terrain_of_Magical_Expertise/

notes.title: Terrain Of Magical Expertise - Patch 210922 is here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40299562/e410030fbc280663de41df73ae42ad1bc17bbfe3.jpg

Greetings Hackers!

The very first update for Terrain Of Magical Expertise is here! This hotfix improves controller support, fixes the issue with Netti limit and fixes the two achievements that weren't working.  Softlocks and other technical issues are still being investigated. We apologize for the delay and hope to have solutions implemented soon!

We would also like to use this oppoturnity to thank all of our fans, who share their feedback and / or support in our Steam Forums. It helps us immensely with identifying bugs and other issues we should fix a thus making the game better for everyone. So here's a huge THANK YOU to all members of our community ❤️

Read the full changelog below:

 Improved Logitech 310 controller support
 Removed a blank control map from WiiU pro controller that may have been causing issues
 Netti changes are now fed through a clamp function to prevent the player's Netti from going above 9999 or below 0
 You may no longer stack multiple Strongest Potions on the same player
 Fixed the "Shatter the Mirror" and "Axe the Squad" achievements

 The White Hat Hacker voiced by Morgan Berry (Yashahime, Dragon Ball Super, Pokemon: Twilight Wings) - https://twitter.com/TheMorganBerry
 Alpha voiced by Alejandro Saab (Fire Emblem: Three Houses, Dragon Ball Legends, Pokemon Journeys)
 Kirbopher voiced by Aaron Dismuke (Fullmetal Alchemist, Dr. Stone, My Hero Academia)
 Flamegirl voiced by Faye Mata (Konosuba!, Fire Emblem: Three Houses, Deathstroke: Knights & Dragons)
